pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal patches with predominantly smooth, curvilinear edges. Patches on the mid-flank are larger in area, while patches on the posterior and proximal hindlimb exhibit a significant reduction in size and increased angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-toned negative space. The pathways exhibit relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the mid-flank, characterized by a high frequency of trivalent junction nodes forming a non-interrupted topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The jagged contour is most distinct along the mid-neck section against the background pixels.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural break in the mane's continuity is visible at the base of the neck where it meets the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark avian organism is visible on the lateral right side of the neck near the shoulder junction, creating a localized silhouette anomaly.
